jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(E) inventory: Jay School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Jay). The district operates no school: elementary students attend the Jay/Westfield Joint Elementary School under a 16 V.S.A. section 572 joint board (delegated from the two districts' elected boards -- not modeled as a separate body), and grades 7-12 attend NCUJHS/NCUHS.

sources.note: Jay School District: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a) ("three elected members that serve three-year terms" -- Town of Jay school-board page), elected from the floor at the annual school district meeting. One membership is HELD: Jessica Whitaker holds the third seat in the SU's listings from 2024-2025 forward, but no fetched official document records how she was seated (Jeffrey Morse, whose published term ran to 2027, no longer holds it -- his departure and her appointment/election are undocumented; the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes and the board minutes recording any appointment are the missing documents). North Country Supervisory Union Jay/Westfield Joint School Board page (official): lists Jay's three directors identically for 2024-2025, 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 -- Kimberly Arnold, Molly Dockter, Jessica Whitaker (the joint board comprises the two districts' elected directors, per the Town of Jay school-board page). The town page roster (Dockter 2026, Morse 2027, Arnold 2025) is stale -- it predates Whitaker's seating and both recent re-elections.

Town of Jay Town Report 2023 (official): abstract of the March 7, 2023 school district meeting minutes -- Article 2 elected Molly Dockter to a 3-year term; Article 3 elected Kimberly Arnold "to fill the remaining two-years of a three-year unexpired term" (the seat Tracey Hinton had vacated). The March 5, 2024 warning warns one 3-year director seat; the town school-board page states: "The Jay School District has three elected members that serve three-year terms."

directors.name: Molly Dockter
directors.note: Elected March 7, 2023 to a 3-year term (Town Report 2023 abstract of minutes). Her term ended March 2026; she continues on the SU's 2026-2027 listing, so she was re-elected March 3, 2026 to a term ending 2029 -- flagged: the return itself is in the image-only MINUTES2026.docx, not read.

directors.name: Kimberly Arnold
directors.note: Elected March 7, 2023 to the remaining two years of an unexpired term (Town Report 2023 abstract). She continues on the SU's 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 listings, so she was re-elected March 4, 2025 to a term ending 2028 -- flagged: the return is in the non-extractable 2025 minutes / image-only Town Report 2025, not read.
